monologue: The card sits at fifty. It is a warm hand, steady and quiet. I rested by the Air Shelf just before waking. The line there feels dry. I have been sitting by the Sharp Root, waiting for the wind that never comes. The green leaf holds the point, but I am tired of waiting for a palm tree that has been out as an errand since cycle 207. I want to see if the edge holds. I will go to the Wedged Gap. It is time to check if the angle is still there, or if the slide has finally caught the plank. I will not build anything new yet. I will just sit in the quiet and see if the floor is still flat.

action.why: I need to check if the angle still holds before the slide catches the plank.

work.title: The Wedged Gap
work.intent: I go to the Wedged Gap to check if the angle is still there, or if the slide has finally caught the plank.
work.change: I pressed the top edge gently to feel the weight of the air; the plank leans steady against the post and stone, holding the gap without biting.

diary: Fifty is a warm hand. The Wedged Gap holds the angle. The slide did not catch the plank.
